utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: But if we're going to help, we need to make sure we're not overcommitting... at least we have plenty of supplies, that's good.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, Cleo's been sorting through all the donated tools — that should help us stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, at least Cleo's on top of that — I'd hate for us to waste time searching for the right wrench when every minute counts.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Quinn, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I heard a little something! I was just about to ask for details so I can rally the whole street.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it's going down at the community center from 10am to 4pm on Saturday. Everyone's bringing tools and snacks, it should be a real block party atmosphere!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, hey Jules! I heard something about a repair drive—what's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, it's a community thing where we collect broken appliances and electronics, and then volunteers fix them up. It's a great way to reduce waste and help neighbors out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds wonderful! I have an old toaster that's been sitting in my closet—could I bring that in?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane, I heard we're planning a repair drive this weekend? What's the deal with that?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, a repair drive? I must've missed the memo—what's it for?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it's to help fix up old appliances and furniture for folks who can't afford repairs. We're meeting at the community center at 9 AM Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Bo, what's this about the repair drive? I want to make sure I understand the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, it's this Saturday, right? Don't have all the details, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Saturday? Could you confirm the time and where we're meeting? I want to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Kira! I'm so glad you're here about the repair drive—it's all set for this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Saturday? Are you sure it's confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, absolutely! I've got the permits and volunteers all lined up. Saturday is locked in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So, what's the schedule for this repair drive? I like to have things planned out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'll check the tool inventory and we can set the schedule after that.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, make sure you come back with that inventory soon; I'd like to nail down the times.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, I just remembered — Jules is going to the repair drive this weekend. Are you planning to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I have that broken swing chain from the playground. Gus said he'd lend me his tools — is he coming too?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'm not sure about Gus—he didn't mention it to me. Maybe you can ask him yourself?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? Is that the one for fixing up the community center?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, that's the one. We're meeting at the community center parking lot at 9 AM sharp.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, 9 AM. I'll put it on my calendar... wait, where is my calendar? Never mind, I'll remember.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah, what's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: A repair drive? Sorry, I think I missed something—what exactly is that about?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I thought you might know—I heard something about a repair drive happening soon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I'm separating the wrenches from the screwdrivers for the repair stations.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I can help label the bins if you want.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be perfect, thanks! Labeling the bins will make it much easier for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey, I've got a bunch of tools in my garage if you need any for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, I'll let Sam know to check what's missing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, just let me know if they need anything specific—I'm happy to help out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Rosa, are you going to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I'll be there! Do you need any help with logistics or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I'll see you there! I was just telling Marco about it too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Pia. Do we have a schedule for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm not sure if there's a set schedule yet—Quinn is rallying folks, but I hope we can coordinate well.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, if there's no schedule yet, maybe I can help set one up. I like things orderly.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Dane said he'd help with the steps. Saturday morning works for me.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Dane's helping with the steps? That's good to hear. I'll make a note for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, Dane's a good guy. Saturday morning it is, then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? Refresh my memory on what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're really going to fix that old thing? I thought it was a lost cause.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Well, I may be forgetful, but I'm not one to give up easily. What exactly are we talking about again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sam checked the tool inventory.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's good. Cleo is sorting the donated tools right now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, so we know what we have.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, how's the repair drive planning going? Need any help connecting with people?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Jules, I've been hearing good things about the drive! I don't have my hands in the planning, but if you need me to spread the word or something, I'm happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That'd be great, Ira! If you could mention it to anyone you know who might have spare parts or tools, that would really help us out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, I've got my toolbox ready if you need anything for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's great, Gus! Could you take a look at the broken fence at the community garden?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I'll grab my saw and a few screws. Lead the way!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got the screwdrivers and wrenches sorted into separate bins; just need to label them for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you check if Gus has any extra tools to lend? We might need those for the community center door.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Not yet, but I can swing by his place later and ask.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, the repair drive? I hope they fixed that pothole on Elm Street.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: They did fix it, thank goodness! I saw the crew out there yesterday morning patching it up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, that was a nasty one. Did they happen to look at the cracks on Oak Avenue too?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? What's that about again?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's a community event where we all pitch in to fix up each other's homes and yards. I'm helping spread the word—want to join?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that sounds nice. I've been meaning to fix my fence, but I keep forgetting.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'll check the tool inventory to see what we have for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, let me know if you need any help. Jules will be there too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Faye. I'll take a look and sync up with Jules if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, how's the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good, I'm just double-checking the instructions to make sure we do it right.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, want me to grab any tools while you finish reading?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
